SELECT /* LGVPAYP0017.retrievePayrollItemDetailList */ ppi.payroll_item_id , ppi.inquiry_name , ppi.pay_item_classification_code , lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGDVHR_PAY_CLASS_TYPE_CODE', ppi.pay_item_classification_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS pay_item_classification_name
, pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id , pid.additional_input_value /* detail_name */ , pid.pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code , lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGDVH_PAY_ITEM_DETAIL_TYPE_CODE', pid.pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS pay_calc_rslt_detail_type_name
FROM tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid WHERE ppi.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
AND ppi.inquiry_name LIKE '%'||#{inquiryName}|| '%'
AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id
AND pid.additional_input_value LIKE '%'||#{additionalInputValue}||'%'
ORDER BY ppi.inquiry_name, pid.sort_order_no
